name: Impact-Resistant & Protective Materials
summary: Explains, at a conceptual materials-science level, how materials absorb impact and resist penetration, as used in helmets, body protection and vehicle and spacecraft shielding.

topics.name: Material behaviour at high strain rates; strain-rate sensitivity
High-rate testing: split-Hopkinson (Kolsky) bar and drop-weight testing
Stress waves, shock waves and the Hugoniot (conceptual)
Energy absorption: crushable foams, honeycombs and crash structures
High-performance fibres and fabrics: aramid, UHMWPE and their energy-absorption mechanisms
Ceramics under impact: comminution, dwell and the role of backing layers
Layered and graded protective systems (conceptual design principles)
Transparent protective materials: laminated glass, polycarbonate, spinel and ALON
Head protection materials and injury criteria for helmets
Constitutive and damage models for impact (Johnson-Cook, Johnson-Holmquist)
Standards and test methods for protective equipment
